definitions: A taxonomic genus within the family Brassicaceae – shepherd's purse.
A taxonomic genus within the family Donacidae – molluscs called bean clams or wedge shells.

blocks.text: Capsella is a mollusc genus in the family Donacidae, the bean clams or wedge shells.
Capsella is a genus of herbaceous annual and biennial plants in the family Brassicaceae. It is a close relative of Arabidopsis, Neslia, and Halimolobos.
